snapshot_policy: Exact first successful generated HTML bytes saved before QA or corrections. Two assembler contract errors occurred before any HTML was produced.

factual_gate.basis: Manual comparison with extracted Word paragraphs, Word table, CSV and rendered supplied SVG: North 12, South 18, reported 31, computed 30, unavailable reliability, synthetic non-operational/non-clinical scope, two stations, count units, absent error bars/confidence intervals and all four directed edges retained.

positive_design_gate.basis: Authentic mark, alternating paper/ink sections, prominent directed graph and varied compositions are present. Mobile axis labels crowd and the desktop cover title is too small.

findings.finding: Source register h3 renders at 21.6 px at minimum root size, below frozen 24 px heading floor.
Reading chart labels reach 10.41 px at an intermediate width; mobile y-axis labels also crowd ticks.
findings.action: Fit chart type to the actual plot width and separate tick/axis geometry.

findings.finding: Short-height CSS overrides the cover title to a content-heading size, weakening cover hierarchy.
findings.action: Keep the cover-specific display size above the compact-height override.

findings.finding: Axis state is stored on a figure using the same data attribute as the select, so reset can select the wrong element after axis interaction.
findings.action: Separate state and control attributes; retest reset.

findings.finding: First behavioral harness includes an evaluated function-assignment error and immediate timing assertions. Nested Escape, hash and scroll restoration need isolated retests.
findings.action: Preserve this run, correct only harness mistakes, rerun real controls.

findings.finding: Detector repeatedly treats intentional ch-based prose measures and text passing behind opaque sticky navigation as defects. Structural scorer also mistakes a play icon for an arrowhead and print pt units for zero-size text.
findings.action: Retain raw findings; recompose real defects and explicitly adjudicate confirmed heuristic false positives without editing installed skills.
